metadata.description: Original Claude Code skills authored from canonical, professionally-written software engineering guides — for autonomous audit-and-fix use, not conversational co-authoring.

plugins.name: swe-writeups
plugins.description: Nine autonomous audit skills for comments, commit messages, code review, testing, refactoring, API design, error handling, naming, and logging — each grounded in one specific, well-regarded engineering writeup. See NOTICE.md for sources.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: Autonomous audit skills for READMEs, code/API documentation, and product marketing copy — each grounded in one specific, well-regarded writeup. See NOTICE.md for sources.

plugins.name: static-analysis
plugins.description: Deterministic linting/type-checking skills for Python (ruff, mypy), Go (go vet, golangci-lint), TypeScript (tsc, eslint), and accessibility/performance (pa11y, Lighthouse) — runs real tools, not stylistic opinion.

plugins.name: product-skills
plugins.description: Adversarial product critique (Marty Cagan's four big risks, Paul Graham) and delight judgment (NN/g, Amber Case). See NOTICE.md for sources.
